idle.title: Idle
idle: Three changes. The canvas moves from pure black to --color-canvas #0b0c10 — a warmer near-black, clearest against the window chrome. The wordmark takes --color-text-primary (ivory #f4f6f1, not pure white) and the secondary action takes --color-text-tertiary. And the window is pinned dark: this Mac is set to Light appearance, so before, the title bar was light grey and the primary button was system blue. The primary is now Uzume violet and the secondary is still quiet grey — that is the scoped tint you asked for.
source_picker.title: Source picker
source_picker: Connector tiles move from Color.white.opacity(0.07) / 0.03 to --color-surface-raised / --color-surface, which land within a level or two of what the translucent fills produced over black. Corner radius 12 is now --radius-md. Note the disabled-tile regression is not visible here because all three sources are enabled; where it does appear, --color-text-disabled and --color-text-tertiary are the same value, so disabled reads slightly brighter than it did (upstream finding 8).
connector_apple_music.title: Apple Music connection
connector_apple_music: Canvas and the text ramp. Unrelated bug spotted while capturing: the status line reads “Checking every 2 secondsu2026” — a literal u2026 where an ellipsis should be, in both before and after. It is a copy string, so DS.1 left it alone; worth its own fix.
connector_spotify.title: Spotify connection
connector_spotify: Canvas, the four white@0.07 panels onto --color-surface-raised, and the inline status marks onto --color-success / --color-warning. The playlist TextField and its buttons stay native.
connector_local.title: Local source connection
connector_local: Canvas plus the action tile's hover state, which is --color-surface-selected on hover and --color-surface-raised at rest.
preparation_active.title: Preparation (in progress)
preparation_active: Canvas; the aggregate progress track moves to --color-surface-selected and its fill to --color-text-secondary; the row divider to --color-line-subtle. Track status icons take the success / warning / danger roles — the danger role is a warm salmon #ff8a75, not systemRed.
playback_chrome.title: Playback — chrome visible
playback_chrome: PerformanceBackdrop, renamed from OverlayBackdropStyle. The measured values do not move: .ultraThinMaterial + 45% black at radius 10. The artwork placeholder fill and the text ramp are the only changes to the card. The transport bar's radius becomes --radius-lg; its surface and coral glow still come from DashboardTokens, deliberately left for DS.6. The preset behind the chrome differs between the two shots — they are different file identities to the planner, so it picked differently. Compare the chrome, not the visual.
playback_chrome_hidden.title: Playback — chrome hidden
playback_chrome_hidden: The preset frame with the chrome auto-hidden. No token touches the renderer; this pair is here to prove it.
shortcut_help.title: Shortcut help
shortcut_help: Panel tint 0.40 kept and named; key caps move to the strong performance fill; the cap radius tightens from 5 to --radius-sm (6).
settings_local_files.title: Settings — Local Files
settings_local_files: Nothing in Settings was retokenized — it held no hard-coded values. What this pair shows is the appearance pin: on a Light-Mode Mac this pane used to render light against the app's black chrome. One thing to judge: the sidebar selection is still system blue, not Uzume violet, because scoping the tint to primary actions leaves List selection on the system accent. Say if you want selection tinted too.
ended.title: Ended
ended: Canvas and text ramp, and the clearest single example of the scoped tint: Start another session is violet, the two secondary links below it stay quiet.
photosensitivity_notice.title: Photosensitivity notice (first run)
photosensitivity_notice: Nothing here was retokenized. It appears because the appearance pin reaches it. The two shots are at different window sizes — the frame is persisted between launches and drifted between the runs.
connecting.title: Connecting
connecting: Not captured. No route reaches it without a live connector credential or a deliberately failing input.
ready.title: Ready
ready: Not captured. The local-file path — the only session route reachable without a connector credential — plays its own audio, so it passes through Ready faster than a capture interval.
preparation_failure.title: Preparation failure
preparation_failure: Not captured. Needs a deliberately failing track.
playback_toast.title: Playback — toast
playback_toast: Not captured. Toasts fire on signal-state, adaptation and display events; none occurred during the capture runs.
permission_onboarding.title: Permission onboarding
permission_onboarding: Not captured. Reaching it means revoking the app's Screen Recording grant, which is a system security setting I will not change.
settings_visuals.title: Settings — Visuals
settings_visuals: Not captured. Driving the settings sidebar hung the automation repeatedly and the pane holds no retokenized code — it would show only the appearance pin that Settings — Local Files already shows. I stopped rather than keep grinding.
settings_diagnostics.title: Settings — Diagnostics
settings_diagnostics: Not captured. Same reason as Settings — Visuals.
settings_about.title: Settings — About
settings_about: Not captured. Same reason as Settings — Visuals.
